problems:
The verdict holds but several numbers are wrong, and all of them understate the ceiling. The verdict: yes, the three together give more than +0.01 lab, but only as a GT oracle; no classifier can capture it before R8; finals stay #37 + #38. The errors:
1. MEASURED JOINT ORACLE IS LARGER THAN THE ANALYTIC ONE. m_joint_oracle's combo_oracle.py finished on all 56 clips, and I aggregated it with the official summarise_rows (scratchpad/combo/v_t1_joint_full_agg.json). All three on the gated pool (O_FP+O_ATT_g+O_LINK) measure +0.02056 (44b6 +0.0235, 6bba +0.0201), not +0.0168. The link part was modelled as 136 dangling FN spread pro rata (+0.0032). The measured GT-relabel link oracle is +0.0073: it removes 25 non-GT edges, adds 151 end->successor edges and makes 136 swaps. For 44b6 it measures +0.0166, against +0.0048 from the pro-rata spread. The wide attach pool keeps 26 TP, not 17: O_ATT_w is +0.0204, not +0.0135. The wide all-three is +0.0412, not +0.0271. O_FP+O_ATT_g alone reproduces: measured +0.01339 vs analytic +0.01353.
2. THE SUPERADDITIVITY NUMBER IS RIGHT BUT THE EXPLANATION IS WRONG. The claim was that 'both shrink the same Jaccard denominator'. Only fork removal shrinks it (T+F+N 130 -> 99). An attach moves FN->TP and leaves T+F+N at 130. The synergy is that each attach TP is worth 1/99 instead of 1/130: 0.1*7*(1/99-1/130) = +0.001686. Measured: singles sum .00629+.00541+.00734 = .01904, the joint is .02056, so +.0015, all on the division side.
3. THE 'ONLY >=70% OF THE ORACLE CLEARS R4' FRAMING IS WRONG. R4 is an absolute +0.012 lab (+0.002 public), not a fraction of the oracle. With the measured oracles that is 58% of the gated all-three and 29% of the wide all-three. The feasibility conclusion survives anyway. On the measured 26-TP wide pool (698 negatives), the equal-variance binormal model gives a division-only joint of +0.0006 at AUC 0.73, +0.0079 at 0.90, +0.0109 at 0.93 and +0.0136 at 0.95. Reaching +0.012 needs AUC about 0.94 on both edit classes at once, with realistic link about 0 (reachable both-free stitch is 11 FN, about +0.0003, precision 0.20 vs break-even 0.48, I-164). On the gated pool the division joint maxes out at +0.0131 and cannot reach +0.012 below AUC about 0.995.
4. AUC 0.73 IS BORROWED. It is I-056's parent-intensity feature for the B22 division re-rank, where IDEAS says the 'ranker power was never measured'. It was never measured on the fork-removal or orphan-attach pools. As an order of magnitude it is fine, but it is not a measured cue AUC for these edit classes.
5. APPLYING 1/6 TO AN ORACLE IS A CATEGORY ERROR. '+0.0028 public for the oracle' does not describe anything real. The 1/6 is shrinkage for in-sample-tuned mechanisms. A true oracle has no public counterpart, and its public ceiling would be about the lab size if the public division statistics are similar. So the 1/6 applies to realistic lab gains only. LESSONS_draft also gives the insertion ratio as '0..0.3 given 3-decimal rounding', so 1/6 is a mid value, not strictly 'the optimistic end'. It is fair to call it optimistic only for fork removers (0 for 5).
6. SMALLER POINTS. The fork-removal oracle is understated by 0.0004 (O_FPgt +0.00671, 20/0 W/L, vs O_FP +0.00629). The per-embryo 44b6 link number was an assumption, and the measured value is 3.4x larger. The gated attach pool is confirmed 100% 6bba (44b6 +0). The wide pool reaches 44b6 (+0.0056). The m_realistic L_flow link arms were 0 on the first 7 44b6 clips.
These errors do not flip the decision. Realistic capture at the measured or borrowed cue strength is still about 2-3% of the ceiling, and R8 (27 Sep 12:00Z) is about 17 h away with no out-of-fold gate possible (44b6: 2 TP / 8 FP forks, 0 gated orphan TP).
corrected:
Measured joint oracle, exp60 56 clips, ins35 base 0.93988, official metric; lab delta ALL (44b6 / 6bba):
- O_FP +0.00629 (+0.00695/+0.00577).
- O_FPgt +0.00671.
- O_ATT_g +0.00541 (0/+0.00634), div 32/31/67.
- O_ATT_w +0.02039 (+0.00557/+0.02292), div 51/31/48 (26 TP).
- O_LINK +0.00734 (+0.01658/+0.00655).
- O_FP+O_ATT_g +0.01339.
- O_FP+O_ATT_g+O_LINK ('all three', gated) +0.02056 (+0.02354/+0.02009).
- O_FP+O_ATT_w+O_LINK +0.04115.
- O_FPgt+O_ATT_w+O_LINK +0.04157.
- Info: O_EDGEALL (every FP edge removed) +0.0646.
Superadditivity +0.0015 (division side, 1/99 vs 1/130 per attach TP).
Answer to the user: yes, and more than +0.01. The three oracles together measure +0.021 lab on the gated pool (+0.041 on the wide pool), not +0.0147 as a sum and not +0.0168. That is a ceiling that needs GT labels.
R4 (+0.012 lab) needs a classifier with AUC about 0.94 on both fork removal and wide orphan attach at once (binormal model; +0.0006 at AUC 0.73, +0.0079 at 0.90, +0.0136 at 0.95), with realistic link about +0.0003. Our best cue is AUC 0.73 and was measured on a different task.
Verdict unchanged: not buildable or honestly gateable before R8. Finals stay #37 + #38. The ceiling (now +0.02..+0.04 lab) belongs to post-deadline I-079. Files: scratchpad/combo/v_t1_joint_full.json, v_t1_joint_full_agg.json, v_transfer_1_check.py/_out.json, v_transfer_1_joint26.json.
